AboutPage.title: About Yokomitsu
AboutPage.subtitle: Over 40 years of excellence and innovation in the global auto parts market.
AboutPage.historyText:
Founded over 40 years ago, Yokomitsu was born with the mission of providing high-quality automotive components to the global market. With cutting-edge production technology and rigorous quality control standards, the brand has won the trust of distributors and mechanics in 22 countries around the world.

Breaking the prejudice about Asian products, Yokomitsu proves that quality, technology, and reliability can coexist with competitive prices. Each part is developed with the highest engineering standards, ensuring performance and durability.
AboutPage.japaneseExcellenceDesc: Each Yokomitsu component carries the legacy of precision and durability that has defined our brand for decades.

1.title: Foundation
1.text: Yokomitsu is founded with a focus on high-quality suspension and steering components.

2.title: Global Expansion
2.text: Beginning of international expansion, establishing partnerships with importers in several countries.

3.title: 22 Countries
3.text: Consolidation of global presence in 22 countries through the IPS (International Parts Suppliers) network.

4.title: Technological Innovation
4.text: Investment in advanced production technology, raising quality standards to OEM level.

5.title: Yokomitsu Brazil
5.text: Represented exclusively by IPS do Brasil, serving the Brazilian market with excellence.

AboutPage.qualityText: We develop suspension and steering parts focused on absolute safety. Our international certifications prove our unwavering commitment to technical excellence.
AboutPage.globalText: Present in 22 countries, our engineering shares global intelligence to adapt efficient solutions to the specific needs of each market, including the challenging roads of Brazil.
AboutPage.certificationDesc: We operate under the most rigorous ISO manufacturing standards, ensuring that each piece delivered to the Brazilian market exceeds safety and durability expectations.
